notes.title: Gladiators and Glory Released to Full Version
notes.notes:
Features added since Early access:
Added Easy, Normal and Hard Difficulty modes
Added Battle Speed Options
2 vs 2 Gladiator Fighting Arena Added
Added 10 arena to 2 vs 2 Gladiator arena.
In 1 vs 1 Gladiator arena, the number of arenas increased from 5 to 10
The number of Gladiator Champions has been increased to 10.
The total number of Gladiators that can be owned has been increased from 3 to 6.
Total number of Gladiators available for purchase increased from 15 to 30.
The number of Gladiator classes increased from 6 to 15.
Gladiator comparison screen has been added to all arenas.
In the Training section in Ludus, the shift key has been added to increase 10 traits.
Cancel option has been added to exit the Find a Fight screen and the Skip to next week screen.
Many bugs in the game have been fixed.
In-game balance has been improved

I would appreciate your support by writing a review.

notes.title: Gladiators and Glory Update
notes.notes: In this update: shift + Left click button to spend 10 Energy and increase your 10 Stats has been added to the game. In the pre-fight Selection Screen, Comparison Texts have been added so that you can better compare the opponents you will fight with your Gladiators. After an opponent is selected, it has been made easier to change your mind and choose another opponent. The balance of the game has been adjusted throughout the game. Fixed a few minor bugs.

notes.title: Two New Arenas Added to Gladiators and Glory with Update
notes.notes:
What's coming to Gladiators and Glory in the update:
7th and 8th Arena unlocked
In your ludus, all stats have been informed.
The Cancel option has been added, allowing you to exit the Find a Opponent screen and the Skip to next week screen.
Many small bugs have been fixed.
